purpose: Authoritative, mode-aware node form-field schema mined from the workflow-builder FRONTEND (zuper-webapp-v3/projects/workflow-builder) + backend consumption. Backs two MCP tools: get_node_field_schema (read) and construct_node_fields (build). Encodes per node → which fields exist, what each is for (what/why/when), value source + exact shape, and DEPENDENCIES: the mode selector, per-mode required/dependent/clear sets, and live-resolved data (meta/filter, custom-field defs). The agent must never guess these — read this + the live catalogue.
value_envelope_note: Almost every form_fields key is a {type, value} group where type ∈ {FIXED, EXPRESSION}. Collections (custom_fields, <module>_fields, conditions, trigger_rules.value) are arrays. 'fixed_or_expression' below says which is allowed.

trigger.applies_to: Zuper-event triggers (job.*, customer.*, …). Webhook/Schedule triggers have NO trigger_rules.

trigger_types.ZUPER_EVENT: A Zuper platform event (job.create, job.status_update, customer.update, …). HAS a per-module trigger filter (trigger_rules).
trigger_types.EXTERNAL_WEBHOOK: Incoming HTTP webhook. NO trigger_rules — filter the payload with a downstream if_else.

filter_catalogue.what: The set of filterable fields is SERVER-DRIVEN and DIFFERENT PER MODULE — never hardcode it. Fetch the module's catalogue and copy each rule's (key,type,field_type,operators) verbatim.
filter_catalogue.endpoint_rule: customers/organization → GET /v2/<key>/meta/filter ; every other module → GET /<key>/meta/filter (mirrors FE trigger.component getFilterUrl). Use node-registry triggerFilterPath(module).
filter_catalogue.note: These 14 modules support a Zuper-event trigger filter. The endpoint key here is the FULL path key (CUSTOMER/ORGANIZATION already include the v2 prefix). construct_node_fields fetches the right one automatically.

trigger_rules.what: The trigger FILTER — only fire when the triggering record matches these rules.
trigger_rules.why: Narrows a high-volume event (e.g. every job.status_update) to the cases the workflow cares about (e.g. status = Completed).
trigger_rules.when: Whenever the user names a condition on the TRIGGERING entity (status is X, category is Y, priority HIGH). On a webhook/schedule trigger this becomes an if_else instead (no trigger filter).
trigger_rules.value_type: array of RULE objects under {type:'FIXED', value:[ RULE… ]}
trigger_rules.fixed_or_expression: FIXED (the array is fixed; rule VALUES are resolved UIDs/enums)
trigger_rules.depends_on: Each rule's (key,type,field_type,operator) MUST be copied VERBATIM from a GET /{module}/meta/filter catalogue entry — see grounding below.

rule_shape.key: catalogue field's fieldDataKey, verbatim (e.g. JOB status = 'status_uid', NOT 'current_job_status.status_uid')
rule_shape.type: catalogue field's `type`, verbatim — one of default_field | nested_field | custom_field. NEVER derived from lookup-ness; read it from the catalogue.
rule_shape.field_type: catalogue field's `fieldType` (LOOKUP | DROPDOWN | MULTI_ITEM | NUMBER | DECIMAL | DATE | DATETIME | TIME | BOOLEAN | TAGS | TEXT)
rule_shape.operator: one of the field's catalogue operators[] (EQUAL_TO | NOT_EQUAL_TO | CONTAINS | NOT_CONTAINS | IS_EMPTY | IS_NOT_EMPTY | GREATER_THAN | LESS_THAN | BETWEEN …)
rule_shape.value: formatted by field_type: LOOKUP → array of UIDs; DROPDOWN/enum → array of enum values; DATE → [fromISO,toISO] with operator BETWEEN; scalar → the value. Omitted for IS_EMPTY/IS_NOT_EMPTY.
rule_shape.displayKeyValue: human labels of the selected values (e.g. ['Completed']) — for chip rendering; include for robustness

trigger_rules.grounding: construct_node_fields fetches GET /{metaApiKey}/meta/filter, finds the field by human name → copies (fieldDataKey→key, type→type, fieldType→field_type, operators→pick operator), resolves the value (LOOKUP name→uid via the field's data.url/dataKey). The FE prefill matches a stored rule to a field ONLY by key===fieldDataKey, so a wrong key renders the filter BLANK on edit even though it executes.
gotchas: JOB job-status field is FLAT: key='status_uid', type='nested_field', field_type='LOOKUP'. The dotted 'current_job_status.status_uid' is PROJECT's key ('project_current_status.status_uid'), NOT JOB's.
No payload-vs-API distinction exists in the FE — the catalogue is event-agnostic. Always use the meta/filter fieldDataKey.
status_type (NEW/COMPLETED/…) is a separate DROPDOWN field ('current_job_status.status_type'); a NAMED status (e.g. 'Completed' as a specific status_uid) uses status_uid + LOOKUP.

excluded_user_uids.what: Users whose actions should NOT fire the workflow (e.g. exclude the automation/system user).

zuper_update.what: Edit an existing Zuper record (status, native fields, custom fields, assignment, schedule, service tasks).

inert_fields.operation_type: Dead dispatcher placeholder — emit {type:'FIXED',value:''}; never use it to select the mode.
inert_fields.source_type: Inert (HTML commented out) but Validators.required — emit {type:'FIXED',value:''}.

source_node.what: Upstream zuper node_uid whose emitted record is the target, OR the literal 'CUSTOM'.
source_node.value_source: an upstream node_uid of the SAME module, or 'CUSTOM'

module_uid.what: The record UID — used ONLY when source_node='CUSTOM'.

operator_type.what: The MODE (what you edit). Selects which dependent block is active and which sibling collections must be cleared.

custom_fields_entry.what: One custom-field write. Setting a CUSTOM field uses operator_type=FIELD (JOB has no FIELD_CUSTOM mode).
custom_fields_entry.identity: id (= def.display_order || def.id) + label (= def.field_name). NOT the custom_field_uid.

shape.key: the field's GROUP NAME, or the literal 'Default' for ungrouped fields. NEVER the custom_field_uid.
shape.label: def.field_name || def.label
shape.module_name: the module literal (JOB/INVOICE/…). NOTE FE bug: CUSTOMER writes 'INVOICE' — backend tolerant; emit the correct module unless byte-matching the FE.
shape.group_name: (only if the def has a group) def.group.group_name
shape.group_uid: (only if the def has a group) def.group.group_uid

custom_fields_entry.grounding: construct_node_fields fetches the module's custom-field definitions (list_custom_field_definitions / GET /settings/custom_fields?module_name=<M>), matches the field by label (or custom_field_uid), and fills the envelope from the def. The agent supplies only {field: <label or uid>, value:<new value>}.

native_fields_entry.what: One native-field write. Collection key = <module>_fields (job_fields, customer_fields, invoice_fields, estimate_fields, asset_fields, property_fields, project_fields, request_fields, contract_fields).
native_fields_entry.shape: { field_key:'<key>', '<key>': { type:'FIXED'|'EXPRESSION', value } } — the value subkey name EQUALS field_key.
native_fields_entry.notes: Address fields carry a structured object value; tags an array; REQUEST preferred-date uses {date,startTime,endTime}.

mode_options._what: Picks WHICH aspect of the record you edit; each option reveals a different sub-form and clears the others.

FIELD_DEFAULT.when_to_use: Change built-in fields (title, priority, dates, address, …). PREFER this for native-field edits.

FIELD_CUSTOM.when_to_use: Set a custom field (e.g. mark "Finished"=Yes). PREFER this for custom-field edits.

FIELD.what: LEGACY combined native+custom edit (renders only if already selected).
FIELD.when_to_use: Do NOT emit for new builds — use FIELD_DEFAULT and/or FIELD_CUSTOM. (Kept for back-compat with old workflows.)

UPDATE_STATUS.when_to_use: Status transitions (job→Completed, invoice→CLOSED). Not available for CUSTOMER/PROPERTY.

UNASSIGN.when_to_use: Take a user/team off the job.

SCHEDULE.what: Set/clear schedule or due date — JOB only.
SCHEDULE.when_to_use: Schedule/reschedule the job or set offsets.

CONVERT_TO_INVOICE.what: Convert a Quote to an invoice — ESTIMATES (module_type=Quote) only.
CONVERT_TO_INVOICE.when_to_use: Turn an accepted quote into an invoice.

status_category.what: The status CATEGORY that owns the target status.

job_status.what: The new job status to set.

job_status_name.what: The status NAME — auto-derived from job_status (read-only mirror).
job_status_name.value_source: auto (set by the FE from the picked status).

sub_operator_type.when_to_use: ASSIGN_FROM_TEAM_USER reveals team+users; ASSIGN_TEAM* needs only team.

offset_type.what: Offset direction for a relative schedule.

duration_type.what: Where the duration comes from (when schedule_value=BOTH).

days.what: Days component of a CUSTOM duration/offset.

service_task.value_source: array of service-task objects (custom or picked).

job_fields.what: Native field writes — see native_fields_entry for the entry shape; per-field meaning in native_field_keys.

custom_fields.what: Custom field writes — see custom_fields_entry for the exact envelope.

native_field_value_sources._note: Each <module>_fields entry sets ONE native field. Value source by field: *_category/*_uid/tags/skills/assignees/property/organization/customer → ACCOUNT_LOOKUP uid(s) via MCP; *_address → structured address object; *_date/*_datetime → date/datetime string; job_type→NEW|REVISIT; *_priority→LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|URGENT; everything else → free text or {{expression}}. The exact key list per module is in modules.<M>.native_field_keys.

customer_fields.what: The native-field collection for this module (each entry sets one customer field).
customer_fields.value_source: array; entry shape = native_fields_entry; per-field meaning in native_fields.

property_fields.what: The native-field collection for this module (each entry sets one property field).
property_fields.value_source: array; entry shape = native_fields_entry; per-field meaning in native_fields.

invoice_fields.what: The native-field collection for this module (each entry sets one invoice field).
invoice_fields.value_source: array; entry shape = native_fields_entry; per-field meaning in native_fields.

estimate_fields.what: The native-field collection for this module (each entry sets one estimate field).
estimate_fields.value_source: array; entry shape = native_fields_entry; per-field meaning in native_fields.

asset_fields.what: The native-field collection for this module (each entry sets one asset field).
asset_fields.value_source: array; entry shape = native_fields_entry; per-field meaning in native_fields.

request_fields.what: The native-field collection for this module (each entry sets one request field).
request_fields.value_source: array; entry shape = native_fields_entry; per-field meaning in native_fields.

contract_fields.what: The native-field collection for this module (each entry sets one contract field).
contract_fields.value_source: array; entry shape = native_fields_entry; per-field meaning in native_fields.

project_fields.what: The native-field collection for this module (each entry sets one project field).
project_fields.value_source: array; entry shape = native_fields_entry; per-field meaning in native_fields.

zuper_update._custom_fields_module_name_note: Per-module module_name literal in the custom_fields envelope. KNOWN FE BUGS: CUSTOMER hardcodes 'INVOICE' (should be CUSTOMER); CONTRACT writes 'CONTRACT' but fetches SERVICE_CONTRACT. ASSET adds an extra is_required key. Build the correct module_name; the worker is tolerant.
zuper_update._field_modes_note: PRODUCTION (origin/features) has THREE field-edit modes: FIELD_DEFAULT (native only), FIELD_CUSTOM (custom only), and legacy FIELD (both, avoid). Setting a custom field → operator_type=FIELD_CUSTOM; native field → FIELD_DEFAULT.

zuper_create.what: Create a NEW Zuper record. FE implements create UIs for JOB and REQUEST only (module-keyed via `module`).

module.value_source: STATIC enum JOB | REQUEST (only these two in FE)

JOB.notes: job_customer present only when company has CUSTOMER module access.

INVOICE.notes: NEW. NO line-item array — line items derive from source_for_line_items (JOB|ESTIMATE) + a linked invoice_job/invoice_estimate UID. invoice_date_mode RELATIVE_TO_EXECUTION|RELATIVE_TO_OFFSET_VALUE; invoice_due_date_offset auto from payment_term.

native_fields_entry.what: One native field. Collection key = <module>_fields. DOUBLE-WRAPPED: { field_key, [field_key]:{type,value} } (the value subkey name EQUALS field_key).

custom_fields_entry.what: Same envelope as zuper_update.custom_fields_entry EXCEPT the ungrouped `key` is the literal "Others" (NOT "Default"), and an `is_required` key is included. FILE/LOOKUP custom-field types are filtered out of the picker.
custom_fields_entry.shares: zuper_update.custom_fields_entry (id+label identity, full envelope, module_name literal)

address_value.what: Structured value for *_service_address / *_billing_address: each sub-key (street/city/state/country/zip_code/first_name/last_name/phone_number/email/landmark/lat/lng) is itself a {type,value} group. Empty = {}.

module.value_source: STATIC enum JOB | REQUEST (only these in FE).

fields._native_note: Other native fields (job_description/job_tags/job_skills/job_property/job_organization/job_type/job_scheduled_*/assigned_users/assigned_teams; request_* equivalents) follow native_field_value_sources: lookups→uid via MCP, addresses→address object, dates→date string, tags/assignees→arrays, else text/expression. Full key list per module in modules.<M>.native_field_keys. Entry shape = native_fields_entry. custom_fields → custom_fields_entry (ungrouped key="Others").

job_fields.what: The native-field collection for this module (each entry sets one job field).
job_fields.value_source: array; entry shape = native_fields_entry; per-field meaning in native_fields.

request_fields.what: The native-field collection for this module (each entry sets one request field).
request_fields.value_source: array; entry shape = native_fields_entry; per-field meaning in native_fields.

source_for_line_items.what: INVOICE: where line items come from.

payment_term.what: INVOICE payment term (auto-sets the due-date offset).

zuper_create._custom_fields_note: zuper_create custom_fields envelope ADDS is_required, show_field_wf, category_uid keys and uses ungrouped key 'Others' (NOT 'Default'); module_name is the runtime module (JOB/REQUEST/INVOICE). (zuper_update uses 'Default' and a module literal.)

zuper_get_record.what: Fetch ONE existing Zuper record so downstream nodes can read its fields (single-record GET — no list/filter/pagination). UI label says "Edit Record" but it is a GET.

source_node.what: Upstream zuper node_uid (same module) whose record is the target, OR the literal 'CUSTOM'.

module_uid.what: Explicit record UID — ONLY when source_node='CUSTOM'.

zuper_get_record.returns: The full fetched record (native + custom fields) — read via $.getNodeData(<this node>).

zuper_custom_field.what: COPY custom-field values from one record (FROM) to another (TO), across/within modules. One FE component serves BOTH zuper_custom_field and zuper_associations.

from_source_node.what: Upstream node_uid emitting the SOURCE record, OR 'CUSTOM'.

from_module_uid.what: Source record UID — only when from_source_node='CUSTOM'.

to_source_node.what: Upstream node_uid emitting the TARGET record, OR 'CUSTOM'.

to_module_uid.what: Target record UID — only when to_source_node='CUSTOM'.

copy_type.what: ALL = copy every custom field source→target; SELECTED = copy only the explicit pairs in associations[].

associations_entry.what: One field→field copy pair (copy_type=SELECTED). value is the custom field DATA_KEY (NOT uid, NOT label).
associations_entry.grounding: data_keys come from each module /meta filtered to field_type=="custom_field" (FROM uses from_module catalogue, TO uses to_module). ORGANIZATION → /v2/organization/meta.

ALL.what: Copy every custom field from source to target.
ALL.when_to_use: Mirror all custom fields across the two records.

SELECTED.what: Copy only the explicit field pairs in associations[].

associations.value_source: array [{associate_from:{type,value:<source data_key>}, associate_to:{type,value:<target data_key>}}] — see associations_entry. data_keys come from each module /meta (field_type=custom_field).

zuper_associations.what: LINK (associate) two existing records across modules — e.g. attach a secondary contact, link a property to a project. Does NOT copy field values (that is zuper_custom_field).

from_source_node.what: Upstream node_uid providing the FROM record, or 'CUSTOM'.

to_module.what: Target module — CONSTRAINED by from_module (adjacency map) + always SECONDARY_CONTACT/CHILD_JOB.

to_source_node.what: Upstream node_uid providing the TO record, or 'CUSTOM'.

to_module_uid.what: TO record uid (when CUSTOM). May accept MULTIPLE uids for certain pairs (e.g. JOB→SECONDARY_CONTACT).

from_source_node.what: Upstream node_uid providing the FROM record, or 'CUSTOM'.

to_module.what: Target module — CONSTRAINED by from_module (adjacency map) + always SECONDARY_CONTACT/CHILD_JOB.

to_source_node.what: Upstream node_uid providing the TO record, or 'CUSTOM'.

to_module_uid.what: TO record uid (when CUSTOM). May accept MULTIPLE uids for certain pairs (e.g. JOB→SECONDARY_CONTACT).

zuper_associations._note: Flat from_*/to_* envelope, NO copy_type, NO associations[] array. from_source_type/to_source_type are inert. to_module options are constrained by from_module.

if_else.what: Conditional branch: evaluate conditions[] combined by AND/OR → route TRUE/FALSE.

combine.gotchas: A {type,value} group, not a bare string.

conditions.gotchas: field_key is a TYPE TAG (STRING|NUMBER|BOOLEAN|ARRAY|OBJECT) that gates the operator set — NOT the data field name. if_else uses EMPTY/NOT_EMPTY/EXISTS/NOT_EXISTS (NOT the trigger-filter IS_EMPTY/IS_NOT_EMPTY). value2 is OMITTED for EMPTY/NOT_EMPTY/EXISTS/NOT_EXISTS. STRING "STARTS WITH" literally has a space.

wait.what: Pause until a duration elapses, a calendar date/time, or an offset from a Zuper date field.

FIXED.notes: Wait for a duration. (Inside a loop, wait_type is forced to FIXED.)

BASED_ON_ZUPER_FIELD.notes: offset_type BEFORE|AFTER; source_field = a date/datetime data_key; source_module set implicitly from source_node.

wait_type.gotchas: value 'FIXED' = wait-for-duration (distinct from the type:'FIXED' envelope).

FIXED.when_to_use: Wait "2 hours / 3 days" before the next step. (Forced inside a loop.)

CALENDAR_DATE.when_to_use: Resume at a specific calendar moment (e.g. 1st of next month, 9am).

BASED_ON_ZUPER_FIELD.what: Pause until an offset before/after a Zuper date field.
BASED_ON_ZUPER_FIELD.when_to_use: Act "1 day before the scheduled start" / "2 hours after completion" — anchored to a record field.

source_node.what: Upstream zuper node whose record carries the anchor date field.

source_field.what: The date/datetime field to offset from.
source_field.value_source: data_key of a date/datetime field on the module's /meta.

offset_type.what: Wait before or after the field value.

schedule.what: SCHEDULE trigger config — fire on a fixed INTERVAL or an rrule RECURRENCE.

INTERVAL.notes: trigger_rules_interval = single-entry array. trigger_interval.value ∈ minutes|hours|days selects which sibling matters (minutes→trigger_at_minute enum 15/30/45/60; hours→hours_between_triggers; days→days_between_triggers + trigger_at_hour 0-23).

RECURRENCE.notes: rrule is a BARE object (no {type,value}). recurrence DAILY|WEEKLY|MONTHLY. WEEKLY→week_day (comma SU..SA); MONTHLY→month_day (comma 1..31, "last"→-1) + optional run_on months. run_at[]={minute:"HH:mm"} (the key is "minute" but holds a TIME string).

INTERVAL.when_to_use: Run every N minutes/hours/days regardless of calendar.

RECURRENCE.when_to_use: Run daily/weekly/monthly at specific times (e.g. every Monday 10:30am).

trigger_rules_interval.value_source: [{ trigger_interval(minutes|hours|days), trigger_at_minute(15|30|45|60), trigger_at_hour(0-23), hours_between_triggers, days_between_triggers }] — trigger_interval selects which sibling matters.

rrule.run_at.value_source: array [{ minute: "HH:mm" }] (the key is "minute" but holds a TIME string).

loop.what: Iterate over an array; runs the loop body once per element. Now HAS a form field (input_data) — was previously structural-only.

input_data.why: Each element runs the loop body once.
input_data.when: Always (else the loop falls back to the previous step output).
input_data.value_source: an expression returning an ARRAY (e.g. {{ $.getNodeData('List Jobs') }} / {{ job.line_items }})
input_data.gotchas: Shape is { value: <expression-string> } — NOT the {type,value} envelope. The UI validates the value resolves to an Array. If blank, the builder auto-uses the previous step output.

input_data.why: Each element runs the loop body once.
input_data.when: Always (else the loop falls back to the previous step output).
input_data.value_source: an expression returning an ARRAY (e.g. {{ $.getNodeData('List Jobs') }} / {{ job.line_items }})
input_data.gotchas: Shape is { value: <expression-string> } — NOT the {type,value} envelope. The UI validates the value resolves to an Array. If blank, the builder auto-uses the previous step output.

split.what: Split into parallel branches — purely structural (outgoing edges).

merge.what: Join parallel branches — purely structural (incoming edges); waits for all branches.

HEADER_AUTH.notes: Bearer/token auth is done HERE (Authorization header), there is NO BEARER mode.

method.gotchas: GET hides the entire body section.

url.gotchas: Must be a literal absolute URL, NOT a whole {{variable}} — the backend new URL() rejects an expression-only url.

error_action.what: What to do on HTTP error.

NONE.when_to_use: Public endpoint, or auth is carried in a header/body you set yourself.

HEADER_AUTH.when_to_use: Bearer/token/API-key auth — put it in header_parameters (e.g. Authorization: Bearer …). There is NO separate BEARER mode.

email_body.value_source: rich HTML; DUAL templating: {{ $... }} = Nunjucks workflow expr, {{ token }} (no $) = Zuper merge-tag resolved server-side.

email_config_uid.what: Sender config (From). OPTIONAL — null = account default mailer.

notification.what: Send a notification. One component drives BOTH internal (zuper_generic_internal_notifications) and customer (zuper_customer_notifications) nodes.

SMS.notes: Plus the recipient block per node type.

PUSH.notes: NOT available for the CUSTOMER node.

template_module.depends_on: notification_type=EMAIL (forced CUSTOMER for the customer node)

email_body.what: HTML email body (dual templating, keyed to template_module).

PUSH.when_to_use: In-app alert to internal users/teams; not available for the customer node.

node_lookup.what: Upstream zuper node whose module anchors the email template (INTERNAL). NEW.
node_lookup.value_source: an upstream zuper node_uid; auto-sets template_module

email_body.what: HTML email body (dual templating, keyed to template_module).

template_module.depends_on: notification_type=EMAIL (forced CUSTOMER on the customer node)

code.what: Run user-defined JavaScript (firejail sandbox). LAST RESORT — prefer native nodes / Nunjucks.

code.fixed_or_expression: PLAIN STRING — NOT a {type,value} envelope (the sole exception across all nodes).
code.value_source: raw JS; sandbox context exposes $item, output_data, variable, axios, moment, _
code.gotchas: JS only (no runtime selector). Backend runs it in a firejail child process.

respond_webhook.what: Return the HTTP response to a webhook caller.

response_body.what: JSON response body (field name is response_body, NOT body).

response_code.what: HTTP status (string; field name response_code, NOT status; default "200").

json.when_to_use: The caller expects a response payload.

_coverage: All node families modelled (2026-06-25 fan-out): trigger, zuper_update, zuper_create, zuper_get_record, zuper_custom_field(+zuper_associations), if_else, wait, schedule, loop, split, merge, http_request, zuper_email, notification(internal+customer), code, respond_webhook. zuper_create FE implements JOB+REQUEST only. loop/split/merge are structural (no form_fields).
_option_docs_note: Each mode-keyed node carries `mode_options`: per-OPTION what + when_to_use for its mode_key field (operator_type/wait_type/schedule_type/authentication/notification_type/copy_type/respond_with). get_node_field_schema returns these so the agent (and a UI tooltip) knows what/why/when for each option.
_fields_coverage: Every node now carries a per-field `fields` map (what / value_source / fixed_or_expression / options / depends_on) covering ALL form fields — beyond the mode_options (per-option) + modes (required/dependent/clear) + envelope shapes. get_node_field_schema returns it.
_source_branch: origin/features (= origin/development, commit c0f68ea975, 2026-06-08) — current PRODUCTION. Re-mined 2026-06-26 after discovering the local ai_builder branch was ~8 months stale.
_prod_realign_note: Re-mined from origin/features 2026-06-26. KEY CORRECTIONS vs the prior (stale ai_builder) schema: zuper_update has FIELD_DEFAULT/FIELD_CUSTOM/FIELD (NOT collapsed to FIELD); loop has input_data; zuper_create adds INVOICE; zuper_associations is a separate LINK node; http_request adds retry/error_action; notification adds node_lookup. Per-module operator_type sets vary (CUSTOMER/PROPERTY have no UPDATE_STATUS; ESTIMATES adds CONVERT_TO_INVOICE + module_type).
